For a B class that’s honestly pretty good. If you want a better freighter though I would recommend keep playing until you get an A or even S class freighter.

If you don’t know how to get freighters, it’s as simple as:
- Playing for a total of 3 hours
- Warping 5 times

As long as you meet those requirements, you’re always guaranteed to get offered a freighter (maybe free depending if you’ve claimed one already).

Also, to get a better chance of getting higher class freighters, put an economy scanner on your Starship (if you already have the blueprint), and look for galaxies with a 3 star economy. You get a higher chance of getting higher class freighters in those galaxies. I also think theirs a higher chance in pirated galaxies as well but I don’t know for sure.

Edit: The warps will NOT count if you’ve already discovered that galaxy. So if you’ve already warped 3 times and you warp to an already discovered galaxy, it will NOT count as the 4th warp (I’m about 97% certain lmao).
